name: Compact Wi-Fi Operations (EDC)
description: The Wi-Fi Pager is Hak5's compact Wi-Fi attack platform designed for covert carry and extended autonomous operation. Small enough to conceal in a pocket or bag, it can be deployed as a passive capture device, rogue AP, or drop implant in space-constrained environments where the full Pineapple is impractical. It is the EDC option for wireless attacks.

blue.det: WIDS detects rogue AP or unusual probe patterns; compact device may be detected during physical search.
blue.cm: WIDS with rogue AP detection; 802.1X on enterprise wireless; X-ray or physical search of bags at entry; NAC preventing unauthorized network access.
